EmailTemplate.name: Blood Booster Reach
EmailTemplate.subject: Join Us as a Blood Booster!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear <name>,
The COVID-19 pandemic has changed many things in our world, and blood collection is no different. While we remain steadfast in our commitment to every patient who needs lifesaving blood, the way in which we serve our mission requires more flexibility than ever. The types of blood drives we can expect to run amidst school and business closures or community viral outbreak impacts efficiency for us and convenience for our valued donors, and both things really matter. As someone who has answered the call to protect patient care in your community in the past, we hope we can count on you to evolve with us as we employ new methods to achieve a stable blood supply despite challenging times for public health. Join us as a Blood Booster, a public advocate connecting willing and able blood donors to the most convenient location to donate near them. What is volunteer service as a Blood Booster? • Protect the stability of the blood supply by creating the efficiency and flexibility of collection needed during these challenging times
• Support your community’s recovery from the impacts of COVID-19, and lift spirits among your team as you work together to fulfill the needs of the most vulnerable among us
• Act as liaison between the American Red Cross and businesses/organizations or your personal connections to drive donations to specific donation events in your area o Share the attached flyer and ask donors to download the Red Cross Blood App to schedule their appointment o Share info about the drives on the flyer in your social media channels or intranet o Recruit other Blood Boosters to extend donation invitations within their networks
We are all in this together, and no matter what role you have played in the past, or hoped to play, we have an urgent need you can help with today—from the safety and comfort of home! We would be so grateful for your partnership! To learn more about becoming a Blood Booster, please reference the attached information sheet.
Sincerely, <Account Representative Name> <Contact Info>
